question: In Linear: Set the estimate to 5 on the "Checkout crash on Safari" issue with the "Crash log" link from PagerDuty uploaded by Maya Chen.
final:
I set the estimate to 5 on WEB-3, "Checkout crash on Safari". I couldn't confirm the PagerDuty "Crash log" link on it.

There are four issues with that title (WEB-1 to WEB-4). I picked WEB-3 because Maya Chen created it, and Jordan Lee created the other three. The API returned an error whenever I asked for attachments, so I couldn't read any of the links. All four descriptions and comment lists are empty too.

If the link is what should decide it, check that WEB-3 has the PagerDuty "Crash log" link. If it's on a different issue, I can move the estimate there.
